description.narrative: Job Creation and Skills Development: The project will create direct jobs during the construction phase and full-time positions during operations. Supply Chain Strengthening: The hotel's food and beverage supplies will be sourced locally. This strategy will benefit Ghanaian SMEs, particularly those in agribusiness and retail sectors, by providing them with stable demand and growth opportunities. Consumer Benefits: The Hampton by Hilton-branded hotel will offer affordable yet high-quality accommodations. This will enhance service standards and accessibility for both domestic and international travelers. Economy Wide Effects: The project is expected to create direct jobs starting from the construction phase and additional indirect jobs via increased supply chain activity generated by hotel operations. The increased spending by employees and travelers in the hotel will translate into economic growth and employment. Sustainable Infrastructure: The hotel will incorporate EDGE-certified green building practices, significantly reducing energy and water consumption. This will set a new standard in the hospitality industry. Climate Contribution: The project aligns with Ghana's environmental sustainability goals by promoting resource-efficient hotel infrastructure. This alignment supports the country's broader climate objectives. Market Expansion: The introduction of an internationally recognized mid-scale hotel brand will stimulate competition in the hospitality sector. Demonstration Effect: The success of this project could serve as a model, encouraging further private sector investments in the hospitality industry, particularly in segments that are currently underserved. Resilience and Sustainability The global brand, will set a new benchmark for hotel quality and service within Ghana's market and strengthen the resilience, sustainability of supply chains in the region.

The proposed IFC investment seeks to support PLP Properties Ltd (PLP or the Company) develop a 170-room 3-star Hampton by Hilton branded-hotel at the Kotoka International Airport in Accra, Ghana (the Project). The Project hotel is expected to receive an EDGE-advanced certification.
